<description>
Part of #36692: remove test state that is shared and modified across cases.

- `script_combineSigs`: The P2PKH, P2SH and multisig cases shared one funding transaction, whose `scriptPubkey` was modified between them, and one keystore. Each case is now its own test with its own keys, keystore and funding transaction.
- `spends_witness_prog`: every output type reused the same transactions and coins view. The P2SH-wrapped cases relied on the `scriptPubkey` left by the previous case and had to clear the `scriptSig` they set. Each check now builds fresh state, and the scripts are named.

The checks are unchanged.
</description>
